scope: Bounded inventory and source-code audit, not production activation or complete source qualification
common_rules: A row can be source-clock admissible while the complete family is not qualified.
An old public event date in the current store is not proof of historical system observation.
Observed-as-run needs source, capture, computation and publication version receipts at the decision cut; public-information replay is a separate registered class.
Complete active-family proof must retain all necessary origins; do not choose a convenient subset to manufacture independence.
Missing coverage or unresolved source identity yields UNKNOWN, not an inactive family or clean control.
Ignition primary registration is A/B/C; Emergence conditionally enumerates D/E/F after their required provenance and timing qualification.
No readiness entry changes Entry Availability, ranking, alerts, plans, sizing, trading authority or source-rights posture.

families.source_owner: Financial News -> stock-library board reducer -> existing B04 projection
families.direction: Direction-neutral attention count; lean is a separate sentiment summary, and missing classified sentiment can produce neutral lean.
families.known_at: Board generation/publication must be reconstructed separately. The chip retains no source publication, capture, item or event-cluster clocks.
families.staleness: Capped recent-feed population; neither a standardized per-ticker historical burst baseline nor a retained exact item-level age policy.
families.independence_identity: Not retained in chip. Headline count and positive/negative counts cannot identify duplicate origins.
families.historical_coverage: Current index: 691 ticker keys, 50 with n_recent>=3, 821 top references; historical coverage depends on exact archived board versions.
families.prospective_readiness: Legacy descriptive proxy only; preserve native input manifest before primary admission.
families.eligible_for_emergence: PROXY_ONLY; not a qualified A exposure on chip fields alone.
families.eligible_for_ignition: PROXY_ONLY; not a qualified A exposure on chip fields alone.
families.row_admissibility: An exact archived chip can describe what the board displayed, subject to its publication cut; it does not supply missing source proof.

families.source_owner: News event ledger and qbus/qkernel; existing ticker-news correctness carrier #8454
families.direction: Neutral information arrival is allowed; bullish/bearish sentiment must remain a separate typed field.
families.known_at: first_seen_utc or _crawled_at is a system clock; seendate has provider-dependent publisher-stated/crawl-bounded meaning. Bind exact source revision and derived/publication clocks separately.
families.staleness: Pin event activation horizon and information-arrival baseline. Do not refresh an old event through a repost or later correction without its explicit event semantics.
families.independence_identity: Native item/event IDs plus deterministic as-of event cluster, correction lineage and explicit upstream economic-origin relation. Cross-host titles differ by item ID; current batch clustering is not complete cross-batch history.
families.historical_coverage: Event log 1,122 rows, captured July11-Oct5; qbus 49,116 items/46,539 keys, captured June19-Oct6. Only 565 qbus rows have nonblank body_sha256. Old seendate values are not old capture history.
families.prospective_readiness: Individual timed records exist. Complete activation manifests, source correction/coverage behavior and cross-family origin joins remain required; #8454 remains open draft.
families.eligible_for_emergence: CONDITIONAL_A_ROW after clock, exact revision, age, coverage and duplicate/origin gates.
families.eligible_for_ignition: CONDITIONAL_A_ROW under the same gates and frozen abnormal-arrival definition.
families.row_admissibility: Some captured records support timed descriptive attention. Two event-log rows with source time later than capture require explicit disposition. Missing body hashes prevent claiming exact-body replay for most qbus records.

families.source_owner: SEC EPS collector, engine/sue, incumbent fusion
families.direction: Cross-sectional seasonal EPS momentum; positive z is not an analyst-consensus beat or necessarily a positive raw change. Legacy boolean accepts nonzero negative z.
families.known_at: Mixed asof_date: synthetic period_end+60 plus real-date overlay, with clock basis and value accession discarded. A last-filed frame value paired with earliest filing date risks future-version leakage.
families.staleness: Legacy sue_fresh_days is not a qualified event-arrival age. Fusion's or-999 fallback also treats a genuine zero-day age as missing.
families.independence_identity: Exact value revision, issuer, metric and fiscal basis are absent from the reduced panel/chip; earnings and its narrative echoes would share a root.
families.historical_coverage: 113,469 rows/2,812 tickers; 82,481 exact60-day lags and 30,988 other lags. Date equality alone cannot label every row's clock basis. Filing-date sidecar absent at pin.
families.prospective_readiness: Historical contextual covariate only; replace the arrival interpretation with the existing qualified earnings-release owner, not a renamed proxy.
families.row_admissibility: Current or archived z may be reproduced as a legacy descriptive value with its exact source vintage; no strict earnings-arrival proof follows.

families.source_owner: EDGAR earnings-8K collector, Earnings Release/receipts, Q06 dossier, D5/B04
families.direction: Actual surprise or comparable factual change only after positive direction and metric/fiscal/accounting/unit/share-basis gates. Filing occurrence itself has no positive sign.
families.known_at: SEC acceptance is a true filing source clock. Exact release/value revision, capture and workspace generation must be bound; an issuer release may precede the filing. Pre-release expectation must precede the actual source event.
families.staleness: Active earnings-event age must be registered from its true release/publication clock; event-date and reporting-period age remain distinct.
families.independence_identity: CIK/accession/body revision, typed earnings event, byte/span receipt and B04 common-information-origin roots. Amendments and retransmissions remain linked.
families.historical_coverage: 173,495 Item2.02 rows/2,765 tickers; no duplicate CIK/accession and all acceptance clocks parse. No row capture clock or general actual/expected-value join. Q06 has one exact AAPL comparison construction proof.
families.prospective_readiness: Useful broad source-clock and narrow exact-fact infrastructure exists; broad comparable surprise production and identity-bound projection remain unproven. D5 security/issuer repair #8004 is open draft.
families.eligible_for_emergence: CONDITIONAL_B_ROW with exact source/value and comparison/expectation proof.
families.eligible_for_ignition: CONDITIONAL_B_ROW with positive direction, all clocks, age and independence.
families.row_admissibility: A filing row can qualify as a public filing observation in the right replay class without qualifying as a positive surprise or observed-as-run exposure.

families.source_owner: SRC-A1/K3E equity-revisions collector and analyst-revisions owner; #8312 physical-source proof
families.direction: Same-fiscal-target aggregate change/acceleration can be typed; contributor-matched upgrades cannot be inferred without contributor history. Consensus change may reflect contributor turnover.
families.known_at: Prospective provider/system observation clocks exist. Source-effective/source-published clocks are null; fetch time is not analyst issuance time. Preserve payload/session/observation and supersession lineage.
families.staleness: Preserve observation age, forecast target and fiscal rollover. A rolling horizon such as 0q with missing period_end cannot prove a same-quarter revision.
families.independence_identity: Observation/session/payload IDs plus matched issuer/security, fiscal target, contributor where available, supersession and common event origin. Revisions responding to one earnings event may share its origin.
families.historical_coverage: Legacy daily history22,951 rows/1,545 tickers June16-Oct5. SRC-A1 495,320 rows/1,506 tickers Aug25-Oct5; 400,060 have both value and period_end. All issuer/security refs, source-issued clocks and contributor IDs absent; all rights UNKNOWN.
families.prospective_readiness: Physical native collection is proven in merged #8312. Identity/basis/comparability and permitted downstream use remain unqualified; retain internal accrual with explicit uncertainty.
families.eligible_for_emergence: NOT_PRIMARY_READY; conditional B aggregate-revision subtype after source-owner gates.
families.eligible_for_ignition: NOT_PRIMARY_READY; analyst upgrade/PT clusters remain outside the frozen primary count.
families.row_admissibility: The receipt can establish an internally captured aggregate observation, not when its underlying contributor issued it or whether it is a comparable revision.

families.source_owner: Typed Earnings Narrative/Release and B04 factual dossier; legacy guidance/RPO stores are research leads
families.direction: Raise/cut/improvement only after comparable guidance/KPI value, interval and basis. Phrase hit or numeric mention alone has no positive revision semantics.
families.known_at: Use exact owner release revision, source availability, capture and generation clocks. Annual source as_of or filing date alone cannot date a changed value or extracted assertion.
families.staleness: Register guidance target/interval, revision event age, supersession and whether withdrawn guidance remains active.
families.independence_identity: Underlying issuer release and metric/target revision, grouped with its earnings event when shared; multiple KPIs do not create multiple evidence families.
families.historical_coverage: Guidance hits18 rows/12 tickers, all polarity null; annual RPO381 rows/75 tickers without retained source-specific capture/revision. Narrow typed release/dossier primitives exist; broad eligible population not shown.
families.prospective_readiness: Conditional exact-fact rows can be assembled through incumbent owners; generic legacy stores are not source-qualified revision tapes.
families.eligible_for_emergence: CONDITIONAL_B_SUBTYPE after source and comparable-direction gates.
families.eligible_for_ignition: CONDITIONAL_B_SUBTYPE; no additional family credit alongside the same earnings origin.
families.row_admissibility: An exact factual guidance/KPI disclosure can be descriptive evidence; a positive change needs its qualified prior/comparison version.

families.source_owner: EDGAR13F collector, smart-money, manager-quality and B04
families.direction: Newly disclosed long common-equity holding or increase between comparable public books; not the date or direction of a current trade, not net inflow.
families.known_at: Filing acceptance and same-version holdings fetched_at are separate. Source receipts carry accession/hash; old period dates do not backdate new capture. After-close acceptance requires next eligible session; system capture can be later still.
families.staleness: Retain period-end age, disclosure age and capture age separately, plus a fixed family age policy. The chip's Q1-2026 caveat is stale while selected periods are Q2. Historical A/B grade needs pre-cut input/grade receipt.
families.independence_identity: CIK/fund/control group, accession/body version, qualified CUSIP/security and both position versions. Multiple managers remain one family. Five issuer cases share three selected filings, all accepted Aug14.
families.historical_coverage: 709 dated original snapshots,51 funds,28,912 rows,2022Q3-2026Q2. Complete clock/hash snapshot rows1,889; legacy/incomplete27,023. Q2 files46/49 complete. Older books and grade input vintages remain uneven.
families.prospective_readiness: Recent single-filing source rows are often well stamped. Primary new/add still needs two qualified books, security mapping, immutable grade vintage and registered age semantics.
families.eligible_for_emergence: CONDITIONAL_C_ROW; stale ownership context remains excluded unless explicitly permitted by the frozen family policy.
families.eligible_for_ignition: CONDITIONAL_C_ROW under identical source, age and grade gates.
families.row_admissibility: Selected Q2 raw source records establish public/capture clocks by the discovery dates. They do not by themselves prove a qualified new/add comparison or a historically lawful A/B grade.

families.staleness: Preserve contract/relationship validity and event age separately; expired, changed or later-learned links cannot qualify retrospectively.
families.independence_identity: Source-grounded relation and exact originating issuer event, not current semantic similarity or later narrative. Read-through and its original release remain linked.
families.historical_coverage: Material8K51,566 rows/665 tickers,2,056 nonblank counterparties. Current graph25,100 edges only MEMBER_OF/EXPRESSES/TRACKS; no audited populated economic-edge family. Existing adapter deliberately refuses inferred role labels.
families.prospective_readiness: Research source leads and identity primitives exist; no broad typed PIT directional relationship path established in this audit.
families.eligible_for_emergence: CONDITIONALLY_ENUMERATED_D; not ready on present generic graph/counterparty rows alone.
families.eligible_for_ignition: SECONDARY_ONLY; excluded from frozen initial exposure.

families.eligible_for_ignition: SECONDARY_ONLY; excluded from frozen initial exposure.

families.eligible_for_emergence: CONDITIONALLY_ENUMERATED_F; no current broad primary readiness claim.
families.eligible_for_ignition: SECONDARY_ONLY; excluded from frozen initial exposure.
families.row_admissibility: A verified source announcement may be retained as a factual source row; positive issuer impact and independent family credit require additional explicit proof.
